block.title: Профессии, места и сильные стороны
block.goal: Понять общий смысл коротких материалов, заметить точные фразы и сказать одну мысль о себе.

checkIn.title: Как прошёл этот блок?
checkIn.purpose: Это не оценка. Выбери только то, что хочешь отметить — так следующий блок будет точнее.

items.prompt: Как тебе в целом этот блок?
Что из этого ты бы выбрал ещё раз?

quizzes.title: После истории: профессии и животные
quizzes.purpose: Не тест British Council: несколько собственных вопросов по теме профессий, животных и фразе с because.

items.prompt: My uncle helps sick dogs and cats. He is a …
items.feedback: A vet helps animals when they are ill.

items.prompt: Choose the sentence that gives a reason.
options: I would like to be a vet because I love animals.
I would like to be a vet yesterday.
I would like be a vet because animals.
items.feedback: After because we give the reason: I love animals.

items.prompt: Choose TWO jobs that can work with animals.
items.feedback: Both a vet and an animal keeper can work with animals.

items.prompt: Say aloud: “I would like to be a … because … .” Then choose the honest answer.
options: I want to try it with an adult

quizzes.title: После слушания: места и свободное время
quizzes.purpose: Собственные вопросы после Cambridge A2: место, занятие и причина выбора.

items.prompt: I’m going to the sports centre after school. What will I probably do?
items.feedback: A sports centre is a place for sport and exercise.

items.prompt: Choose the best ending: “I like going to the park because …”
options: I can meet my friends there.
items.feedback: A because-clause explains why you like something.

options: Where do you go after school?
Where do you went after school?
items.feedback: For a present routine we say: Where do you go …?

items.prompt: Say one true sentence about where you go after school. Then choose the honest answer.
options: I want a model from an adult

quizzes.title: После чтения: Our best things
quizzes.purpose: Проверить понимание прочитанного, не переводя текст слово за словом.

items.prompt: What is Tom really good at?
items.feedback: Tom is an excellent swimmer and daydreams about swimming in the sea.

items.prompt: What does May want to practise for the school championship?
items.feedback: May is very good at table tennis.

items.prompt: Why can’t Tom have play time at first?
items.feedback: Mrs Potter wakes Tom because he is daydreaming.

items.prompt: Choose TWO people and their best things from the story.
items.feedback: Huang is brilliant at languages, and Ollie is the town’s chess champion.
